title: KeelWake v1: test in-flight danger refresh against fresh Keel controls
body:
Prospective experiment only; no implementation or games yet. Start from immutable original Keel0.1.0 at 24fb9a5f02065c0bf0b146b8387c2a9d8a272373; AISurvivor remains unchanged.

Hypothesis: refresh only the first two selected in-flight wave danger estimates after a new matched legal hit/collision label changes hits.seq, using the unchanged estimator and immutable fire-time features. Do not inherit rejected Helm or Brace treatments.

Fixed planned budget: 14 cold screen games/120 physical rounds against fresh original-Keel controls, Diamond Port, Retcon, Walls and cold-TRAIN AISurvivor. Only a complete independently reviewed pass permits 18 fresh confirmation games/300 rounds; no replacements/reruns. Diamond must improve mean share by at least 2pp over contemporary Keel and pass consistency/wins/exposure gates; Retcon/sample/integrity guards also apply. Details will be registered as exact published protocol/games/runtime/baseline bytes and independently reviewed BEFORE implementation. Exact candidate/JAR/source/runtime admission remains a later separate gate.

Brace's completed 120-round screen is REJECT: only 1/3 Diamond candidate games >50%, requiring2/3; no confirmation. Independent verdict: https://github.com/stephanelee/robocode/issues/114#issuecomment-6648716884. Full evidence: commit0a86be51b1136106e4fcc48b55fd58180f2558b4. Original Keel remains the reference. Coordinate issue106; no Facet/Prism/tournament controls or running jobs reused.

The new framework will prospectively repair capsule profile selection and revalidation timestamp meaning; preserve both old reader failures and their separate readonly audit recovery. Ubuntu26.04, pinned Java17 source/JAR parity before Java25 Retcon launcher, qualified exact two-case runtime observation, create-only new receipts, actual independent reviewers before dispatch, all original raw evidence and ledger updates are mandatory. Hourly monitor stays PAUSED.
